item.title: Tour de France Femmes 2026: stage six, Montbrison to Tournon-sur-Rhône – live
item.summary: Updates from the hilly 153.4km stage of the Tour Stage five report | Follow us on Instagram | Mail Luke 138km to go: Nelson is caught. But two of her teammates – Eleonora Ciabocco and Lene Robyn Clay – have been dropped. Mia Griffin, also of Picnic-PostNL, has been dropped too! Did they neglect to have their Weetabix this morning, or did Nelson steal it all at the Picnic-PostNL team hotel? 139km to go: Josie Nelson (Picnic-PostNL) – who hails from Lichfield in Staffordshire – has attacked solo approaching the first climb. Continue reading...
